```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/dns_records?type=CNAME
Authorization: Bearer secret123
```

The JSON response will include a `data` array; each element’s `id` field is the ID of a CNAME record. Extract those `id` values to get the list of related object IDs.
